errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the timing and values of the jumps in the purple line. The chart shows a jump to approx. 123 in July 2022 and a subsequent large jump to approx. 141 in October 2022. The description hallucinates a single sequence of jumps, placing a jump to 123 in January 2023 and a jump to 141 in July 2023, both of which are incorrect in timing.
The description states that the dark blue line is at approximately 145 around January 2024. However, the chart shows the value at that time is closer to 149.
The description states that the dark blue line is at approximately 150 around January 2025. The chart shows the value at that point is closer to 153.
